# TradeHQ

> TradeHQ is a free, no-signup paper-trading simulator for stocks, crypto, ETFs, forex, and commodities. Beginners get $100,000 in virtual cash, 170 practice instruments, a rule-based educational mentor with authored explanations, source-labelled charts, and an optional public practice leaderboard. The simulator never executes real-money orders.

TradeHQ is an educational simulator (not a brokerage). Trades use virtual money; asset data may be live, cached, delayed, or simulated depending on availability and is labeled in the product where applicable. Content is written and maintained by Anuga Weerasinghe. TradeHQ does not provide financial advice.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.thetradehq.com/): What TradeHQ is, how the free simulator works, key features.
- [Trade](https://www.thetradehq.com/trade): Free trading terminal with 170 practice instruments, virtual order entry and labelled quote/chart provenance.
- [Markets](https://www.thetradehq.com/markets): Full asset universe — stocks, crypto, ETFs, forex, commodities.
- [Portfolio](https://www.thetradehq.com/portfolio): Virtual portfolio, P&L, maximum drawdown, open-position dispersion and allocation analytics.
- [Leaderboard](https://www.thetradehq.com/leaderboard): Public ranking of virtual traders by return.
- [Learning Mentor](https://www.thetradehq.com/ai-mentor): Authored explanations matched to educational questions; not live investment analysis, broker advice or a personalized prediction.
- [About](https://www.thetradehq.com/about): Mission, creator, transparency.
- [Contact](https://www.thetradehq.com/contact): How to reach the TradeHQ team.

## Learn (courses & guides)

- [Learn hub](https://www.thetradehq.com/learn): Free structured trading courses for beginners.
- [Trading Guide](https://www.thetradehq.com/learn-trading-guide): Comprehensive beginner-to-intermediate trading guide.
- [Structured Courses](https://www.thetradehq.com/courses): Four educational tracks with quizzes and completion badges.
- [Options Trading Fundamentals](https://www.thetradehq.com/courses/options-trading-fundamentals): Calls, puts, Greeks, spreads and risk.
- [Futures & Derivatives](https://www.thetradehq.com/courses/futures-and-derivatives): Contracts, margin, contango/backwardation, hedging.
- [Macro Reading for Traders](https://www.thetradehq.com/courses/macro-reading-for-traders): CPI, FOMC, yield curve, DXY.
- [Trading Psychology Mastery](https://www.thetradehq.com/courses/trading-psychology-mastery): Biases, tilt, journaling, discipline, drawdowns.
- [Roadmap](https://www.thetradehq.com/roadmap): Upcoming TradeHQ features and improvements.

## Wiki (defined terms)

- [Trading Wiki](https://www.thetradehq.com/wiki): Plain-language glossary with individual learning exercises and source-specific examples.
